parts.desc: reset 移动分支指针，让该提交不再位于当前分支后续历史中；其改动是否保留取决于模式。revert 保留原提交，再追加抵消它的提交。
parts.desc_en: Reset moves the branch pointer so the commit is no longer in that branch's later history; whether its changes remain depends on the mode. Revert keeps the original commit and adds an offsetting commit.

variants.when: 撤销提交但保留改动，方便重新整理后再提交
variants.when_en: Undo the commit but keep the changes to restage them

variants.when: 把分支移回前一提交，并覆盖之后已跟踪文件的暂存与工作区状态；执行前先检查
variants.when_en: Move the branch to the previous commit and replace later tracked-file index and working-tree state; check first

variants.when: 已推送的提交要撤销，不改写共享历史
variants.when_en: Undo a pushed commit without rewriting shared history

use.t: 尚未共享、确定要移回前一提交时，可用 reset；先检查暂存区和工作区
想保留改动、只重做提交时，用 reset --soft 回到提交前
共享分支上要抵消某条提交时，优先评估 revert，并检查它是否产生冲突
reset --hard 会覆盖目标提交之后已跟踪文件的暂存和工作区状态，执行前先检查

dont.t: 未与协作者约定就重置共享分支并强推，改写同事可能依赖的历史
没看清参数就用 reset --hard，连未保存的改动一起丢掉
不看目标提交和后续改动就 revert，忽略它可能需要人工解决冲突
撤销后不重新运行验证，以为历史回到过去功能也回到过去

lessonPractice.title: 误加调试入口的提交 C 已共享；同事之后又提交 D。要抵消 C 并保留 D，怎样做？

options.label: 查看 C 与 D 的改动后，用 git revert C 追加抵消提交，再复查结果
options.feedback: 对。revert 会在现有历史后追加提交；检查新差异，确认只抵消 C 并保留 B、D 的改动。若修改重叠，先解决冲突再验证。

options.label: reset 到 C 之前并强推，删掉 C 和之后的提交 D
options.feedback: 这会改写同事已经依赖的共享历史，还会把之后的 D 一起从分支线上移走。

options.label: 用 git revert HEAD 撤销最新提交 D，再推送
options.feedback: HEAD 指向同事之后提交的 D；撤销它会丢掉帮助说明，调试入口 C 仍在。要指定需要抵消的提交。

en.title: Commit C added a debug entry and was shared; a teammate later made commit D. How can you offset C and keep D?

options.label: Review C and D, use git revert C to append an offsetting commit, then check the result
options.feedback: Correct. Revert appends a commit to the current history; inspect the new diff to confirm it offsets only C and keeps B and D. Resolve any overlapping edits before verifying.

options.label: Reset to before C and force push, removing C and later commit D
options.feedback: That rewrites history teammates may already use and also removes D from the branch line.

options.label: Run git revert HEAD to undo the latest commit D, then push
options.feedback: HEAD points to the teammate's later D; reverting it removes the help update while leaving debug entry C. Name the commit you intend to offset.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 提交 C 误加了调试入口，之后同事又提交了 D。请检查 C 和 D 的差异，用 git revert C 追加抵消提交；先说明可能的冲突，只处理与 C 相关的部分。确认 B 的导航和 D 的内容仍在、调试入口已移除，再运行页面验证并告诉我新提交号。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Commit C accidentally added a debug entry, and a teammate later made D. Review the diffs for C and D, then use git revert C to append an offsetting commit. Explain possible conflicts and only resolve the parts related to C. Confirm B’s navigation and D’s content remain, the debug entry is gone, rerun the page, and tell me the new commit hash.
